unauthorized: A service Bearer token is required.
invalid_input: Provide control_time as ISO 8601 with a time zone.
invalid_json: Expected one JSON object matching the selected endpoint contract; request limit is 1 MiB.
unavailable: Both analysis and export models must be configured for the full pipeline.
busy: All processing slots are busy. Try again later.
storage_error: Could not persist the pipeline audit. No completed result is confirmed; further stages have stopped.
generation_failed: A pipeline stage failed. Inspect the saved run audit and provider configuration.
invalid_model_output: The model returned an unexpected structure. Details are saved in the audit; subsequent stages were not started.
timeout: A stage or the full pipeline exceeded its time limit. Earlier results are saved in the audit.
cancelled: The pipeline request was cancelled. Earlier results are saved in the audit.
content_filter: Yandex stopped the response with its content filter. Partial output is saved in the audit; no automatic retry occurred.
max_output_tokens: The model reached its output token limit. Check the affected stage's token budget; partial output is saved in the audit.
refusal: The model refused the request. Its response is saved in the audit; no automatic retry occurred.
invalid_sites: Provide sites as an array of 1 to 5 public sites: domains or HTTPS URLs without duplicates.
sites_unavailable: Could not configure search for the supplied sites. Check service configuration.
invalid_control_time: Provide control_time as ISO 8601 with a time zone.
invalid_period_start: period_start must equal control_time minus 24 hours.
dataset_required: A nonempty dataset name is required in news.json.
items_required: An items array is required in news.json; an empty array is allowed.
invalid_article_ids: Each material must have a nonempty, unique id.
analysis_input_too_large: Eligible article text exceeds 120,000 characters; reduce the dataset.
